metadata.advisorTitle: Faculty Advisor & Professor, Dept. of Mechanical & Mechatronics
metadata.leadershipQuote: At KGEC Robotics Society, we do not merely assemble components—we engineer autonomous intelligence and push mechanical endurance to its absolute physical limits. From sleepless prototyping nights in the Kalyani lab to champion podiums at national arenas across India, our members prove that world-class robotics is born from relentless passion, peer mentorship, and engineering grit.

sectionTexts.heroSubheading: Official institutional portal of KGEC Robotics Society. Documenting over a decade of combat mechatronics, autonomous navigation, aerial systems, and national tournament victories from Kalyani Government Engineering College.
sectionTexts.overviewSubtitle: Specialized R&D research wings working in cross-disciplinary teams to engineer world-class combat machines, rovers, and aerial platforms.
sectionTexts.projectsSubtitle: Precision-engineered battlebots, autonomous rovers, and aerial platforms built by student engineers in the KGEC prototyping lab.
sectionTexts.eventsSubtitle: Eastern India's premier autonomous robotics tournaments, national combat arenas, hands-on maker bootcamps, and 36-hour hackathons.
sectionTexts.teamSubtitle: Honoring the faculty mentors, elected student office bearers, domain technical leads, and alumni engineers driving society excellence.
sectionTexts.roadmapSubtitle: Institutional milestones for international arena championships, hardware infrastructure expansion, and student STEM incubation.
